read: the close rose 2.01% from saturday 17 october to saturday 24 october, the first green week since the week that closed on saturday 26 september, after drops of 9.98%, 5.43% and 13.34% in the 3 weeks before. it sits 1.41% above the 50 week average, the 5th close above that line in the 51 weeks our series carries it, since 2 november 2025. hashrate read 380.94 PH/s on saturday 24 october and averaged 361.41 PH/s from 18 to 24 october, against 351.97 PH/s from 11 to 17 october, in our own daily log.

_hinweise.week: der tag an dem der post rausgeht, format JJJJ-MM-TT. steht die woche schon in der history, passiert nichts und der lauf bleibt gruen. das datum ist der schalter, erst wenn du es hochstellst geht ein post raus.
